outcome: success rate of a trial of labor (TOL)
cohort: The study included 35 female patients with pelvic fractures (28 pelvic ring, 5 acetabular, 2 combined) who had subsequent pregnancies, with 12 patients having operative fixation and 23 not.
finding: A majority of women had successful vaginal deliveries after pelvic fractures, with or without fixation, suggesting that these patients should consider a trial of labor.
mod_finding: The fixation and control groups had no observed difference in successful TOL, but patients who failed a TOL were more likely to have Tile B/C pelvic fractures and more pelvic displacement.
